deviations.reason: This dev machine is NixOS, not FHS Ubuntu; /usr/bin and /bin do not contain bash/find/awk/git. Built PATH from command -v lookups of each required tool instead, achieving the same intent (a minimal, explicit tool set) without assuming Ubuntu's directory layout.
